1879064144.name: Pressing Attack
1879064144.desc:
An AoE double-strike inflicting moderate damage.

Requires Battle-readied State.

Using this skill enables the Battle-hardened state, boosting healing and defences.

Critical hits trigger a Defeat Response.

1879104848.name: Plague Gourd
1879104848.desc: A plague of flies fills a foetid gourd which explodes on your opponent.\n On critical hit, reduces your opponents Block, Parry, and Evade for 20s.

1879110224.name: Call to Fate
1879110224.desc: Requires Dissonance or Melody Stance.\n\nDeals Light damage to a single target, with a high Critical chance.

1879138640.name: Plague of Flies
1879138640.desc: A gourd filled with flies is launched at your opponent. After the gourd is cracked open, the flies will swarm out obscuring vision and draining power from nearby targets, restoring Power to the Defiler.\n\nFlies are only able to blind Players.

1879160016.name: Prized Galadhrim Horse
1879160016.desc: The Galadhrim have chosen to honour you with one of their prized horses.

1879182800.name: Mischievous Delight
1879182800.desc: Your Mischievous Glee extends to your fellowship, restoring both Morale and Power.

1879213904.name: The Stroke of Midnight (Tactical)
1879213904.desc: Your fellowship attempts to strike Draigoch with a final blow.

1879216336.name: True Heroics
1879216336.desc: Restores the power of your Fellows and increases your melee damage while slowing all enemies around you.

1879233360.name: Piercing Toss
1879233360.desc: A piercing attack which deals Light Damage over time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879238096.name: Power of Knowledge
1879238096.desc: Lightning wreaths your enemy while restoring your own power.\n\nDamage will not interrupt the drain.

1879242320.name: Mearas-lore
1879242320.desc: One with nature and the elements the Mearas are adepts at using the natural world against their enemies; as students of nature, beasts and hidden lore so too are Lore-masters who study these wild horses.

1879243984.name: Cry Havoc
1879243984.desc: A damaging cry that has the potential to truly disrupt your enemies and inspire you and your allies.

1879244240.name: Trick: Stratagem
1879244240.desc: A good Burglar knows how to plan for any situation and how to apply their knowledge to the best outcome at all times.

1879244880.name: Skill of the Eorlingas
1879244880.desc: The ultimate expression of tactical horsemanship, this is a dangerous strike on its own; when enhanced by the Red Dawn Discipline your melee damage is increased.

1879248336.name: Coda of the Eorlingas
1879248336.desc:
You unleash the culmination of your musical efforts into a power blast of light-based damage affecting an enemy target and those near the enemy.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 3 ballad buffs present on the Minstrel.</rgb>
<rgb=#00FFDD>Active Anthems add enhanced effects to the Coda.</rgb>

<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Ballads from the Minstrel.</rgb>
<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Anthems from Minstrel.</rgb>

1879255504.name: Mounted Strike
1879255504.desc: A simple passing attack that increases attacking strength when successful.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Increases Fervour by 1</rgb>

1879271248.name: The Ancient Master
1879271248.desc:
Drawing upon your deep well of knowledge and lore, you are able to focus your abilities, improving many skills.
Each time you use an improved skill, you will expend one Mastery.

<rgb=#00CCFF>Fire and Frost Lore:</rgb> Becomes AoE
<rgb=#00CCFF>SoP:Righteousness:</rgb> +20s Duration
<rgb=#00CCFF>SoP:See All Ends:</rgb> Doubled Effectiveness
<rgb=#00CCFF>SoP: Vigilance:</rgb> Increases allies' Critical Defence
<rgb=#00CCFF>Air Lore:</rgb> Applies a Bubble
<rgb=#00CCFF>Water Lore:</rgb> Becomes AoE
<rgb=#00CCFF>Beacon of Hope:</rgb> Increased Potency
<rgb=#00CCFF>Wind Lore:</rgb> Increased Potency
<rgb=#00CCFF>Burning Embers:</rgb> Becomes AoE
<rgb=#00CCFF>Gust of Wind:</rgb> Increased Damage and applies Brittle Frost
<rgb=#00CCFF>Wizard's Frost:</rgb> Becomes AoE and Increases Enemy Inductions
<rgb=#00CCFF>Wizard's Fire:</rgb> Devastating Burn
<rgb=#00CCFF>Wizard's Spark:</rgb> Stuns Target

1879286480.name: Trap - Caltrops
1879286480.desc: A bunch of caltrops that stick in enemies feet and continue to damage them.

1879288144.name: Sword Sweep
1879288144.desc: A powerful sword swing that damages enemies in front.

1879302608.name: Call to Arms: Archer (Pilgrim)
1879302608.desc: You enlist an Archer to assist you in battle.

1879322064.name: Overbearing
1879322064.desc: Even in the darkest times, you give your allies hope.\n\nThis ability can be used in combat.

1879326032.name: Steed of the Yield
1879326032.desc: A horse from the Farmers Faire.

1879335504.name: Tamed Variag Hound
1879335504.desc: Summons a tamed Variag hound to keep you company.

1879335632.name: Battle-worn Steed of the White City
1879335632.desc: A pony from the White City who took part in the Battle of the Pelennor Fields.

1879369424.name: Songbird
1879369424.desc: Brings out a songbird to keep you company.

1879411792.name: Quick Feint
1879411792.desc: A sudden feint leaves your enemy off-balance and grants you the Mettle to quickly finish them.

1879447376.name: Formal Corgi
1879447376.desc: Brings out a friendly corgi to keep you company.

1879478480.name: Composure
1879478480.desc: You briefly regain yourself, increasing your Morale.

1879486032.name: Friend of Large Hunters (Savannah Pride-keeper)
1879486032.desc: Summons a big cat companion.\n\nThe cat is capable of attacking multiple foes at once.

1879492176.name: Acrid Salts
1879492176.desc: Acrid salts from the wastes of Malenhad force your target to awaken with a renewed blood lust.

1879496912.name: Guise of Galadriel
1879496912.desc: A finely-crafted costume in the guise of Galadriel. Will you be fair and terrible such that all will love you?

1879506256.name: Muster at Dun Shûma
1879506256.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Dun Shûma in Khûd Zagin in the Ikorbân Valley.

1879507792.name: Devotion: Acid Pestilence
1879507792.desc: Devoting yourself to acid, you draw upon the poison, diseases, and virulence within the world. With this power, you transform all your damaging skills into acidic attacks.

1879528272.name: Prepared: Shadow Breath
1879528272.desc: Using fell knowledge and potions, breathe a gout of living shadow upon your foes.

1879528784.name: Prepared: Acid-spike
1879528784.desc: Send a spike of acid at your target, weakening them.

1879529168.name: Test GroundTargeting
1879529168.desc: This is a ground-targeted skill with limited targets.
